newsitem.title: USA: Piper Jaffray Q2 net up on revenue rise.
newsitem.headline: Piper Jaffray Q2 net up on revenue rise.

text.p: Piper Jaffray Cos said Wednesday that revenue growth and lower expenses contributed to posting a profit in the second quarter ended March 31 compared to a loss a year ago.

Piper Jaffray also said it is a defendant in lawsuits or arbitrations related to various funds or assets managed by Piper Capital. The total cost of litigation or judgments or settlements could have a material adverse effect on consolidated financial statements.
The company reported net income of $7.5 million, or $0.39 a share, compared with a loss of $2.3 million, or $0.13, in the same period in 1996.
Revenues climbed 11 percent to $153.3 million from $137.6 million in the second quarter last year.
The year-ago loss stemmed from a $14 million class-action litigation settlement related to closed-end funds managed by Piper Capital Management, Piper Jaffray said.
Piper Jaffray is a financial services holding company.
Its shares were off 1/4 Wednesday at 16-3/8.
